title: H-NS / Fis binding domains
description: Original study mid-exponential H-NS and Fis binding intervals in the first 500 kb. Other study growth phases are retained as a separate comparison array.
reference: E. coli MG1655; original study genomic bounds, exact accession not stated in interval table
processing: Read the original study supplementary bindingregions tables distributed by BioStudies/EuropePMC. Retain intervals whose source left bound is <500000. Preserve source start and end exactly. Primary records are mid-exponential Fis and H-NS; phaseComparison retains all six source protein/phase combinations. Primary numeric value is right bound minus left bound, the reported endpoint separation. No binding-strength measurement is supplied or invented.
coordinateSystem: Original reported MG1655 genomic interval bounds; table does not document origin/end-inclusivity convention. Bounds are preserved unconverted; value is end-start.
limits: Primary view is mid-exponential condition and first 500 kb only.
No binding strength is given in these peak-bound tables; span is not binding strength.
Coordinate origin and end inclusivity are not documented in the supplied table; exact bounds and endpoint separation are shown.
Exact reference accession is not stated in the retrieved interval table; do not silently overlay on a different genome build.
